item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R07-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R07-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The party-law framework requires equal treatment in public benefits, written party statutes and programs, regular disclosure of leadership information, member participation, elected party organs, secret elections for party leadership and certain party representatives, minority proposal rights, and independent party arbitration courts not bound by instructions.","notes":["The excerpt supports secret elections for party leadership and representatives, but does not include the separate rule on secret selection of electoral candidates."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R07-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R07-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R07-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R07-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
